summary: NestFinder full-stack testing completed. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/me/role toggle), properties (list/filter by type/price/q/bedrooms, get single, 404, create authz, mine, delete authz), bookings (create/mine/landlord/patch status w/ authz). Seed inserts 2 demo users + 8 properties as expected. Frontend: onboarding → login (demo tenant) → home with chip filter (horizontally scrollable) → property detail → Book Now → Booking form submit → Request Sent success screen → Bookings tab shows PENDING → Profile Switch to Landlord toggles role + tabs update to Listings/Requests + landlord home shows + button. All critical flows work. Only minor React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) — not blocking.

issues: Console emits deprecation warnings from react-native-web: 'shadow*' style props (should migrate to boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' (should move to style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' equivalent and move 'pointerEvents' prop into style to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Consider standardizing booking form testIDs with '-input' suffix (currently 'booking-name', 'booking-phone', 'booking-date') for consistency with other screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~510 lines - acceptable but if it grows further split routers into modules.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded in all responses via projection ({"_id": 0}).
JWT_SECRET has a hard-coded fallback ('nestfinder-secret-change-me') - for production this should be enforced from env only.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] is fine for preview but review for prod.
seed_data_creation: None created by tests beyond a few TEST_ prefixed users/properties/bookings via API — properties created during landlord CRUD test are cleaned up (delete verified with 404).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://nest-search-6.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo creds: tenant@nestfinder.app / Demo123! and landlord@nestfinder.app / Demo123!. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend testIDs discovered: onboarding-{screen,signup-btn,login-btn}; login-{screen,email-input,password-input,submit-btn,google-btn,error,back-btn,to-register}; home-{screen,search-bar}; chip-{All,1BHK,2BHK,3BHK,Single Room,PG/Hostel}; properties-list; prop-card-<id>; property-detail-screen; detail-{back-btn,title,book-btn}; booking-form-screen; booking-{back-btn,name,phone,date,submit-btn}; booking-success-screen; view-bookings-btn; bookings-screen; profile-{screen,add-property,bookings,switch-role,logout}; landlord-add-btn; empty-add-property.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. Initial pytest failures were due to test data using reserved TLD (.test) which pydantic EmailStr rejects (fixed by switching to @example.com).
